alternatives.name: Technitium DNS
alternatives.description: Full authoritative + recursive DNS server with blocking.
alternatives.database: File-based for core data - server config and zone files stored under a 'config' folder (/etc/dns in Docker). Query logging is an OPTIONAL app: 'Query Logs (Sqlite)' uses SQLite, with MySQL and SQL Server also available as optional log-app backends. No external database required to run the DNS server itself.

alternatives.name: Restic
alternatives.description: Fast, secure, deduplicating backup CLI to many backends.
alternatives.database: None - not a service and uses no database. Restic is a backup CLI that writes to a content-addressable repository on a storage backend (local dir, SFTP, REST server, S3/object storage, etc.). No DBMS.

alternatives.name: Duplicati
alternatives.description: Encrypted, scheduled backups to cloud/S3 with a web UI.
alternatives.database: SQLite (one server database plus a per-backup local database; the local DB is a cache/catalog of remotely stored data and can be rebuilt from the destination)
deploy: Docker (official multi-arch image duplicati/duplicati: linux/amd64, linux/arm64, linux/arm/v7)
Linux packages for x64, Arm64, and Arm7/ArmHF (NAS / Raspberry Pi)
Runs as a service / Windows service

alternatives.name: Kopia
alternatives.description: Cross-platform encrypted backup with snapshots and a UI.
alternatives.database: No traditional database - uses its own content-addressable block storage (CABS) repository format. Data/metadata/index BLOBs (p/q/x prefixed packs) are stored in the repository backend (filesystem/NAS, S3-compatible, cloud, etc.); a local cache directory is used for performance.
deploy: Docker (official kopia/kopia images for amd64, arm64, and arm on DockerHub)
Native binaries / packages (Windows 10+, macOS 10.11+, Linux: amd64, arm64, armhf)
